title: Speaking: Interview Academic Situations
focus: Lidar com preferências e situações universitárias
verifiableTask: Responder cinco perguntas sem leitura de roteiro

content.text: : escolher entre duas opções, dizer o que você faria, comparar experiências. Tudo
Ao final da aula você consegue:
responder cinco perguntas sem leitura de roteiro.
Would you rather live in a dorm or in an apartment?
Would you rather take an exam or write a paper?
If you could study any subject for free, what would you choose?
If I were in that situation, I'd…
— quem não faz sua parte no grupo
If my roommate were noisy, I'd talk to him.
I'd like it / I like it
If I had more time, I'd rather join a club than take another elective.

options.text: If I had more time, I'd join a club.
If I have more time, I'd join a club.
If I would have time, I join a club.

explanations.general: Correct answer: If I had more time, I'd join a club.

questions.questionText: I'd ______ live in a dorm than in an apartment. (preferiria)

explanations.general: I'd rather live in a dorm than in an apartment.

questions.questionText: A “free-rider” in a group project is someone who…

options.text: rides a bike for free
doesn't do his or her part of the work
leads the group

explanations.general: Correct answer: doesn't do his or her part of the work

questions.questionText: An optional course is called an ______.

explanations.general: An optional course is called an elective.

options.text: than
to
of

questions.questionText: My ______ this semester is huge: five courses and a job. (carga de trabalho)

explanations.general: My workload this semester is huge.

content.text: Responder sem roteiro: a técnica das 3 palavras
Antes de falar (2–3 s), pense em
Imagine one member of your group project isn't doing any work. What would you do?

I'd probably talk to him privately first, because maybe he has a problem we don't know about — like a part-time job or a family issue. I'd try to give him a smaller task with a clear deadline. If that didn't work, I'd talk to the professor, not to complain, but to make sure the grade is fair. That actually happened to me in college, and talking directly solved the problem.
O aluno faz sombra do modelo e depois responde com uma solução diferente.
I can watch the lectures again
→ write a paper / take an exam / I can think more carefully → live with a roommate / live alone / it's cheaper and less lonely → do an internship / take summer classes / I'd get real experience
→ I failed an exam / talk to the professor about my mistakes → I got a scholarship abroad / accept it immediately → a class were too easy / ask to move to a higher level
Para cada pergunta, o aluno diz só 3 palavras-chave em 5 segundos. Depois responde.
Would you rather have one long exam or several small quizzes?
What would you do if you couldn't get into a course you needed?
Which is more useful: a club or an internship?

questions.questionText: If my roommate ______ very messy, I'd suggest a cleaning schedule. (be — 2ª condicional)

explanations.general: If my roommate were very messy, I'd suggest a cleaning schedule.

options.text: I'd rather to take an online course.
I'd rather take an online course.
I'd rather taking an online course.

explanations.A: Depois de “I'd rather” não se usa “to”.
explanations.general: Correct answer: I'd rather take an online course.

questions.questionText: In the model, what would the speaker do first?

options.text: Talk to the group member privately
Complain to the professor
Do the work alone

explanations.general: Correct answer: Talk to the group member privately

questions.questionText: If I failed an exam, I ______ talk to the professor. (forma completa de 'd)

explanations.general: If I failed an exam, I would (I'd) talk to the professor.

questions.questionText: What is the “3 keywords” technique for?

options.text: To memorize a full script
To organize ideas quickly before speaking
To make the answer shorter

explanations.general: Correct answer: To organize ideas quickly before speaking

questions.questionText: Online classes aren't ______ interactive as face-to-face classes. (tão)

explanations.general: Online classes aren't as interactive as face-to-face classes.

content.text: 5. Tarefa cronometrada: 5 perguntas sem roteiro (15 min)
nada. Tem 5 s para pensar em 3 palavras-chave e 30–45 s para falar.
Would you rather live on campus or off campus during your first year? Why?
What would you do if you realized you had chosen the wrong major?
Some students take a gap year before university. Would you recommend it?
Which is more important for a student: good grades or extracurricular activities?
Imagine your professor offers extra credit for volunteering. Would you do it? Why or why not?
o aluno responde de novo a pergunta com menor nota.

Escreva uma frase sobre você com cada palavra de situação universitária.
Responda às perguntas 1–3 da tarefa (sem roteiro, 45 s cada).
Would you rather have a famous professor or a friendly one?
Ouça suas gravações e anote 3 erros. Regrave a pior.
Fale junto com o modelo da seção 3 e depois crie uma versão com solução diferente.

options.text: I prefer living on campus to living off campus.
I prefer living on campus than off campus.
I'd rather living on campus.

explanations.C: Depois de I'd rather: verbo base.
explanations.general: Correct answer: I prefer living on campus to living off campus.

explanations.general: If I chose the wrong major, I'd change it quickly.

questions.questionText: Many students do an ______ to get work experience. (estágio)

explanations.general: Many students do an internship to get work experience.
